name: Outlaw Speedway
hoursNote: Race nights typically Friday evenings, April through October; Thursday Night Thunder special events scheduled periodically — check website for full seasonal calendar.
description: A 4/10-mile semi-banked clay dirt oval in Dundee (Yates County), formerly Black Rock Speedway and now one of New York's premier weekly dirt-track venues. Friday-night programs feature Modifieds, Crate Sportsman, Street Stocks, Sprint Cars, and 4-Cylinders; major specials include the Short Track Super Series and the annual $25,000 Fireworks Spectacular.
